Why families fall for Maltipoos

A cross between a Maltese and a Poodle, the Maltipoo is gentle, clever and eager to please. The soft, low-shedding coat suits many allergy sufferers, and the small size fits apartments and houses alike.

They love company, so they do best with people who are home often and happy to cuddle.

Questions, answered

Do Maltipoos shed?

Very little. Their hair-like coat sheds minimally, though it needs regular brushing to prevent tangles.

Are they good with children and other pets?

Yes. They are gentle and playful, but young children should always be supervised around small dogs.

How big will my Maltipoo get?

Most adults weigh 5 to 12 lbs and stand 8 to 14 inches tall.

How much exercise do they need?

Short daily walks and indoor play are enough for most. They are energetic but not demanding.

Can they stay home alone?

They bond closely with their people and can develop separation anxiety, so build alone-time up gradually.

How often should I groom?

Brush several times a week and plan a trim every 6 to 8 weeks. Start early so grooming feels normal.
